description: Per-instance execution image overrides. Each entry is bound to the official instance image it was derived from and is verified by full image ID at runtime. A missing or mismatched override image fails closed; it never falls back to the official tag.

overrides.reason: Original pvlib image has NumPy 2.0.2 with PyTables 3.9.2 (cp39 wheel built for NumPy 1.x ABI), so conftest import fails before collection. Phase 17 pinned NumPy to 1.26.4 without changing /testbed, tests or the official harness logic; the official harness then produced 19 passed and RESOLVED.
Official parent lacks pytest-httpbin: existing network test fixture recursively depends on itself. Install pytest-httpbin 2.0.0 only; original source and tests unchanged.
